shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && ls app 2>/dev/null; ls src 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/
cat app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; find node_modules/next/dist/docs -iname "*cookies*" -o -iname "*headers*"

(npx next dev -p 3123 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3123/ && break; sleep 1; done
echo "--- no cookie, no Accept-Language:"; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o '<dl>.*</dl>'
echo "--- theme=dark, Accept-Language: fr-CH, fr;q=0.9, en;q=0.8:"; curl -s -H 'Cookie: theme=dark' -H 'Accept-Language: fr-CH, fr;q=0.9, en;q=0.8' http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o '<dl>.*</dl>'
echo "--- q-weights out of order: en;q=0.5, de;q=0.9:"; curl -s -H 'Accept-Language: en;q=0.5, de;q=0.9' http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o '<dl>.*</dl>'
echo "--- empty theme cookie:"; curl -s -H 'Cookie: theme=' http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o '<dl>.*</dl>'
pkill -f "next dev -p 3123"; grep -i -E "error|warn" /tmp/dev.log | head
